brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single cell at 0,0,0 with solid cover on top (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and 6 solid caps sealing side faces (caps at 30/90/150/210/270/330 deg). Base bottom is closed. MeshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: hex-port-louvre installed as port:0#0 at slot 0, vented without letting rain in per catalog.

finish.summary: Built single-cell closed enclosure (12 parts incl. caps/cover + louvre): all 6 side faces capped solid, top covered solid, with hex-port-louvre providing breathing vent for electronics board.

events.text: Your vented enclosure is on the workbench — I'll get it closed up with a breathing louvre.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I’ve mapped the vent and closure points — now I’ll seal the box and fit the louvre.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.

events.text: The main shell is sealed — just giving the enclosure a final check for complete closure.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
